Kolkata March Blocked, Sparks Row Over Mamata's Rally

A planned rally by West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee in Kolkata was blocked, leading to a row over the crackdown on her march. The Trinamool Congress (TMC) had organized the rally against the Centre and the Election Commission. National Herald reported that the anti-Gyanesh rally was blocked and the crackdown on Banerjee's march sparked the row. The Pioneer noted the TMC's plan for the rally against the Centre and the Election Commission.
